About Trail conditions Members' Benefits Schedule Club GoPasse Rates

Ski Guarantee

Relax, we’ve got your back!

 

Not satisfied with the conditions after 1 or 2 runs? No problem, we’ve got you covered:

  • You have a maximum of two runs to decide if the conditions meet your expectations.
  • Visit the Customer Experience Desk within one hour of your first scan at the lift access gates with your GoPasse.
  • Receive a new ticket, equivalent to your original purchase, for a future visit or a *ticket for the Viking and Snow Tubing Park.
  • Applies only to ski or snowboard tickets purchased at the regular season rate starting December 15 of the current season.

* Subject to the activity’s schedule and availability.
